{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Compute response rates by sex
total_by_sex = df.groupby('sex').size()
responded_by_sex = df.groupby('sex')['responded'].sum()
response_rate_by_sex = responded_by_sex / total_by_sex

print("Response rates by sex:")
print(response_rate_by_sex)

# Check if the groups are comparable by severity and site
print("\nCross-tabulation: sex vs severity:")
print(pd.crosstab(df['sex'], df['severity']))

print("\nCross-tabulation: sex vs site:")
print(pd.crosstab(df['sex'], df['site']))

# Check response rate by sex within each site
response_by_sex_site = df.groupby(['sex', 'site'])['responded'].agg(['count', 'sum', 'mean']).round(4)
print("\nResponse rate by sex within each site:")
print(response_by_sex_site)"}
